independenceDeclaration.statement: Every row was independently solved from its EN/ZH prompt. Existing oracle, response audit, QA status, candidate verdict, and learner explanation were not treated as mathematical proof.

reviewMethod: Read all 233 EN and ZH prompt pairs side by side and checked exact mathematical equivalence, numbers, units, quantifiers, requested parts, and response format.

Independently recalculated every fraction, decimal, mixed-number, integer, order-of-operations, unit-conversion, factorisation, divisibility, exponent, H.C.F., L.C.M., short-division, and application result.
Reviewed all 529 accepted-answer forms individually for mathematical validity and compliance with requested method or representation requirements.
For all 62 multiple-choice rows, evaluated every EN and ZH option independently and recorded the unique correct zero-based option index.

Reviewed both learner explanations for correct substantive reasoning and scanned learner-facing explanation fields for internal QA, S18, A18, audit, oracle, grader, candidate, pending, or review prose.

Scanned every learner-facing prompt and topic title in this shard for raw tabs, repeated spaces, stray spaces before punctuation, ASCII sentence punctuation in Chinese prose, and bilingual entity mismatches.

checkDefinitions.exactEnZhMathematicalPromptEquivalence: The prompts ask the same mathematical task with matching numbers, units, conditions, and response requirements; harmless typography is separately reported.
checkDefinitions.unambiguousSolvability: The prompt supplies enough information and has a determinate answer under the stated school-mathematics convention.
checkDefinitions.canonicalAnswerCorrect: Independent solution agrees with the stored canonical answer exactly in mathematical meaning.
checkDefinitions.everyAcceptedAnswerFormMathematicallyVal: Every stored acceptedAnswers entry was inspected and is a valid response.
checkDefinitions.methodAndRepresentationRequirementsSatis: Accepted structured responses retain every explicitly requested part, method, trace, explanation, or notation.
checkDefinitions.multipleChoiceOptionsAlignedAndUniquelyC: EN/ZH option arrays correspond and each locale has exactly one correct option.
checkDefinitions.substantiveCorrectExplanationZh: Traditional Chinese explanation contains correct learner-facing reasoning.
checkDefinitions.substantiveCorrectExplanationEn: English explanation contains correct learner-facing reasoning.
checkDefinitions.noInternalQaOrS18ProseInLearnerExplanati: Neither explanation exposes internal QA, S18, A18, audit, oracle, grader, candidate, pending, or review instructions.
checkDefinitions.gradeAndTopicPlausible: The demand is plausible for stored S1 Basic computation.
checkDefinitions.learnerFacingSpacingAndPunctuationClean: No learner-facing raw tabs, inconsistent repeated spaces, stray punctuation spacing, or ASCII sentence punctuation defect was found.

issues.problem: Raw U+0009 tab characters are used before and between the I/II/III labels and values, unlike the clean English list.
issues.recommendation:
Replace tabs with consistent newline-plus-single-space list formatting: 下列何者能同時被 4 和 6 整除？
I. 276
II. 578
III. 840。

issues.problem: Raw tab characters occur in the list, spacing around H.C.F./L.C.M. is inconsistent, and there is a stray space before the full stop in “120 。”.
issues.recommendation: Normalize to “已知某兩個整數的 H.C.F. 和 L.C.M. 分別是 30 和 120。…” and replace list tabs with single spaces.

issues.problem: Raw tab characters format the I/II/III list and the opening quantity is joined directly to Chinese text (“10638能…”).
issues.recommendation:
Normalize to “10638 能被以下哪些整數整除？
I. 4
II. 6
III. 9”。

issues.problem: Raw tab characters format the I/II/III list, and mathematical quantities are inconsistently joined to Chinese text.
issues.recommendation: Replace tabs with newline-plus-single-space list formatting and use consistent spacing around 4, 6, 2, and 3.

issues.problem: A learner-facing Chinese sentence ends with ASCII “?” and joins 78 directly to adjacent Chinese text.
issues.recommendation: Use “以下哪個不是 78 的因數？”。

issues.problem: The I/II/III list uses inconsistent runs of two or three spaces, and quantities are joined directly to Chinese words.
issues.recommendation: Normalize each list line to one space after the label and consistent spacing: “I. 2 000 可以被 2、5 和 10 整除。” etc.

crossShardObservedIssues.note: Fresh exact-SHA lookup proves these seven rows are in shard B, not indices 468..700; they are recorded here fail-closed without misattributing them to shard C.

conclusion: All 233 rows are mathematically and bilingually semantically correct, including all accepted answers and MC choices. The shard is not fully clean: six learner-facing Chinese prompt spacing/punctuation issues require repair. Seven additional topicTitleZh spacing defects were verified outside this boundary at indices 241..247 and recorded without misattribution.
